summary: A status report from SRI's Augmentation Research Center and Network Information Center. Its conversion to a PDP-10 running TENEX was nearly done after some obscure bugs, including a noisy ground traced to bad memory data. Reliability was about one crash every day or two, and work turned to network software.

eli5.summary: A team says their new computer mostly works now. It had a sneaky electrical problem that made it forget things, but it is fixed and they will connect to the network next.

questions: what was the sri arc nic status in 1971
what problems did the tenex conversion have
